instructions: Download all seven ZIPs to the Lab project root.
Verify the complete part-name set before extracting.
Use a new empty staging directory experiments/3d-lab/assets/import-v035-full/.
Each archive contains complementary relative paths. Extract ALL to the same staging directory, preserving meshes/.
Reject absolute paths, .. path traversal and unexpected overlapping file paths. Do not overwrite unrelated project files.
Validate every file against SHA256.json from part01; stop if any file is missing or differs.
No scripts need to be run merely to extract or load the data.
completeZipAlternative: D3-v035-complete-CustomGeometry.zip provides the same payload in one archive; do not combine complete ZIP with partial set.
